about: The reported-problems gate (npm run test:reported, tools/reported-gate.js): every player-reported problem that was fixed (closed, or labelled fix-merged, with the confirmed label) and the tests that fail if it comes back. The gate runs these tests with the whole of tests/guides-reported.test.js, the judge's player-report seeds (forge judge seed-tests) and the danger-at-the-spot gate (#1575). A fix for a report adds its issue here with the test that pins it; a report with nothing left to check says why (uncheckable). tests/reported-gate.test.js checks that every test named here exists.
